body.title: Help
body.lead: Answers to the questions members ask most.

sections.heading: How does a business get verified?
sections.body: The owner submits the listing and agrees to the statement of faith. The Jubilee verification team reviews it and publishes it, usually within two business days.

sections.heading: Does Jubilee take payment?
sections.body: No. You send a booking, quote or order request, the business confirms it, and you pay the business directly in the way they offer.

sections.heading: Is it free?
sections.body: Yes. Joining, messaging and listing a business are all free.

sections.heading: Who can see my messages?
sections.body: Only you and the business you are writing to. Our team reads a conversation only when one of you reports it.

sections.heading: How do I report a listing?
sections.body: Open the listing and choose Report at the bottom of the page. Reports are private and reviewed within one business day.

body.title: Privacy
body.lead: We collect only what the marketplace needs to work, and we never sell it.

sections.heading: What we keep
sections.body:
- Your name, e-mail, and optional phone, neighbourhood and home church name and address. Your home church is shown to no one.
- Messages and requests you send, so both sides can see them.
- For businesses: listing details.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: Change what we e-mail you in [notification settings](/account/notifications), and download or delete your account from [your account](/account).

sections.heading: Privacy contact and your rights
sections.body: To see or correct the personal information we hold about you, write to our privacy contact at [privacy@jubilee.example](mailto:privacy@jubilee.example). We answer within 30 days, as Canada’s privacy law (PIPEDA) requires.

body.title: Statement of faith
body.lead: Jubilee is open to everyone as a customer. Businesses that list here agree to the commitments below, and every listing is verified before it goes live.

sections.heading: What we believe
sections.body: We believe in one God — Father, Son and Holy Spirit — and that Jesus Christ is Lord. We hold the Bible to be God’s word and our guide for faith and for work.

sections.heading: How we do business
sections.body:
- We tell the truth about what we sell, what it costs and when it will be ready.
- We treat every customer with the same care, whatever their background or belief.
- We keep our word, and we put it right when we fall short.
- We see profit as something to steward: for our families, our churches and our city.

sections.heading: How a listing is verified
sections.body: Each owner agrees to these commitments when listing. The Jubilee verification team reviews every listing before it goes live. Read more in [Help](/help).

body.title: Terms of use
body.lead: These terms cover using Jubilee as a member and as a listed business. Jubilee introduces buyers and businesses; the agreement to buy is between the two of you.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You need to be 18 or older and use your real name. Keep your password to yourself and tell us if someone else has used your account.

sections.heading: Listings
sections.body: Businesses are responsible for the accuracy of their listing, prices and credentials. We may pause a listing while we look into a report.

sections.heading: Requests and payment
sections.body: Bookings, quotes and order requests are sent to the business, which confirms or declines them. Jubilee does not take payment or hold funds; you pay the business directly.

sections.heading: Conduct
sections.body: Be honest and kind in messages. We remove accounts that harass, mislead or spam other members.
